open_points.subject: run-spool removal after ending or releasing a run
open_points.text: “a store call that fails changes no record ... and the request is answered as an internal error by module:surface” conflicts with “a removal that fails or is interrupted fails nothing”
open_points.question: When capability:store.remove_run_spool fails after the run-ending or release record was committed, is the request answered internal_error and the process stopped, or does the request succeed while leftover files await startup cleanup?
options: Treat spool-removal failure as non-fatal and retry cleanup at a later start
Answer internal_error and stop the kernel after preserving the committed run record
open_points.default_guess: Treat spool-removal failure as the explicit non-fatal exception in A14 rule 4.

open_points.subject: startup recovery of operation elements whose former wait has ended
open_points.text: “reaching again, through capability:effects.reach_operation_element, an operation element whose wait no longer holds”
open_points.question: Which operation elements are reached again during recovery, given that an unknown attempt resolved applied must conclude without another send, while a decided approval or a not_applied resolution may require reaching the element again?
options: Reach only elements whose approval is now decided or whose not_applied resolution requires a fresh approval; derive applied resolutions without reaching them
Reach every operation element whose stored waiting point no longer applies
open_points.default_guess: Derive applied resolutions as concluded and reach only elements that still require the A11 continuation path.

open_points.subject: bindings.check_installed_instances startup manifest validation
open_points.text: “a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it”
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks apply at startup when check_installed_instances has a service and selected instance but no operation name or proposed ports?
options: Check only record structure, service identity, selected-instance facts and headers needed for the credential-collision check
Validate every capability entry in the service record
Do not fail startup for unrelated capability defects; defer them to proposal, acceptance and send
open_points.default_guess: Check only the record and selected-instance facts needed to validate installed header collisions, deferring operation-specific checks.
